1: // Endless Asteroid Dodger
2: // Canvas with id="game" must exist in the HTML.
3: // Ship rotates left/right (←/→) and thrusts forward (↑). Asteroids spawn randomly.
4: // Collision or fuel depletion ends the game. Score = distance traveled.
5: 
6: (() => {
7:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
8:   if (!canvas) return console.error('Canvas #game not found');
9:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
10:   const width = canvas.width = canvas.clientWidth || 800;
11:   const height = canvas.height = canvas.clientHeight || 600;
12: 
13:   // ==== Game state ====
14:   const ship = {
15:     x: width / 2,
16:     y: height / 2,
17:     angle: 0,
18:     vx: 0,
19:     vy: 0,
20:     radius: 10,
21:     fuel: 100,
22:     distance: 0,
23:   };
24:   const asteroids = [];
25:   // Generate starfield background
26:   const stars = [];
27:   const starCount = 100;
28:   for (let i = 0; i < starCount; i++) {
29:     stars.push({
30:       x: rand(0, width),
31:       y: rand(0, height),
32:       radius: rand(0.5, 1.5),
33:     });
34:   }
35:   const keys = {};
36:   let lastTime = 0;
37:   let gameOver = false;
38: 
39:   // ==== Input ====
40:   window.addEventListener('keydown', e => {
41:     keys[e.key] = true;
42:     // Start audio context on first interaction (required by browsers)
43:     if (audioCtx.state === 'suspended') audioCtx.resume();
44:     if (e.key === 'ArrowUp' && ship.fuel > 0) {
45:       // Thrust sound
46:       playSound(400, 0.05);
47:     }
48:   });
49:   window.addEventListener('keyup', e => (keys[e.key] = false));
50:   // ==== Audio ====
51:   const audioCtx = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
52:   const playSound = (freq, duration = 0.1) => {
53:     const osc = audioCtx.createOscillator();
54:     const gain = audioCtx.createGain();
55:     osc.frequency.value = freq;
56:     osc.type = 'square';
57:     osc.connect(gain);
58:     gain.connect(audioCtx.destination);
59:     const now = audioCtx.currentTime;
60:     gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.001, now);
61:     gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.2, now + 0.01);
62:     gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, now + duration);
63:     osc.start(now);
64:     osc.stop(now + duration);
65:   };
66: 
67:   // ==== Helper functions ====
68:   const rand = (min, max) => Math.random() * (max - min) + min;
69:   // Generate an irregular polygon for asteroid shape
70:   const generateAsteroidShape = (radius) => {
71:     const points = [];
72:     const sides = Math.floor(rand(7, 12));
73:     for (let i = 0; i < sides; i++) {
74:       const angle = (i / sides) * Math.PI * 2;
75:       const r = radius * rand(0.7, 1.0);
76:       points.push({ x: Math.cos(angle) * r, y: Math.sin(angle) * r });
77:     }
78:     return points;
79:   };
80:   const spawnAsteroid = () => {
81:     const edge = Math.floor(rand(0, 4)); // 0=top,1=right,2=bottom,3=left
82:     let x, y, vx, vy;
83:     const speed = rand(0.5, 2);
84:     const angle = rand(0, Math.PI * 2);
85:     const radius = rand(15, 30);
86:     switch (edge) {
87:       case 0: x = rand(0, width); y = -20; break;
88:       case 1: x = width + 20; y = rand(0, height); break;
89:       case 2: x = rand(0, width); y = height + 20; break;
90:       case 3: x = -20; y = rand(0, height); break;
91:     }
92:     vx = Math.cos(angle) * speed;
93:     vy = Math.sin(angle) * speed;
94:     // store shape points for drawing
95:     asteroids.push({ x, y, vx, vy, radius, shape: generateAsteroidShape(radius) });
96:   };
97: 
98:   const update = dt => {
99:     if (gameOver) return;
100:     // Ship controls
101:     if (keys['ArrowLeft']) ship.angle -= 3 * dt; // rotate 3 rad/s
102:     if (keys['ArrowRight']) ship.angle += 3 * dt;
103:     if (keys['ArrowUp'] && ship.fuel > 0) {
104:       const thrust = 0.1;
105:       ship.vx += Math.cos(ship.angle) * thrust;
106:       ship.vy += Math.sin(ship.angle) * thrust;
107:       ship.fuel = Math.max(0, ship.fuel - 10 * dt); // fuel consumption
108:     }
109:     // Move ship
110:     ship.x += ship.vx;
111:     ship.y += ship.vy;
112:     // Wrap around edges
113:     if (ship.x < 0) ship.x += width; else if (ship.x > width) ship.x -= width;
114:     if (ship.y < 0) ship.y += height; else if (ship.y > height) ship.y -= height;
115:     // Track distance
116:     ship.distance += Math.hypot(ship.vx, ship.vy) * dt;
117:     // Asteroids update
118:     asteroids.forEach(a => {
119:       a.x += a.vx;
120:       a.y += a.vy;
121:       // wrap
122:       if (a.x < -30) a.x += width + 60;
123:       else if (a.x > width + 30) a.x -= width + 60;
124:       if (a.y < -30) a.y += height + 60;
125:       else if (a.y > height + 30) a.y -= height + 60;
126:     });
127:     // Collision detection
128:     for (const a of asteroids) {
129:       const dx = a.x - ship.x;
130:       const dy = a.y - ship.y;
131:       if (Math.hypot(dx, dy) < a.radius + ship.radius) {
132:         gameOver = true;
133:         break;
134:       }
135:     }
136:     // Fuel depletion ends game
137:     if (ship.fuel <= 0) gameOver = true;
138:     // Periodic asteroid spawn
139:     if (Math.random() < 0.02) spawnAsteroid();
140:   };
141: 
142:   const draw = () => {
143:     // Fill background
144:     ctx.fillStyle = 'black';
145:     ctx.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);
146:     // Starfield
147:     ctx.fillStyle = 'white';
148:     stars.forEach(s => {
149:       ctx.beginPath();
150:       ctx.arc(s.x, s.y, s.radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
151:       ctx.fill();
152:     });
153:     // Ship draw (triangle with gradient)
154:     ctx.save();
155:     ctx.translate(ship.x, ship.y);
156:     ctx.rotate(ship.angle);
157:     const grad = ctx.createLinearGradient(-12, -6, 12, 6);
158:     grad.addColorStop(0, '#ffdd33');
159:     grad.addColorStop(1, '#ff8800');
160:     ctx.fillStyle = grad;
161:     ctx.beginPath();
162:     ctx.moveTo(12, 0);
163:     ctx.lineTo(-8, 6);
164:     ctx.lineTo(-8, -6);
165:     ctx.closePath();
166:     ctx.fill();
167:     ctx.restore();
168:     // Asteroids (irregular polygons)
169:     ctx.strokeStyle = '#888';
170:     ctx.fillStyle = '#555';
171:     asteroids.forEach(a => {
172:       ctx.beginPath();
173:       const shape = a.shape;
174:       if (shape && shape.length) {
175:         shape.forEach((pt, i) => {
176:           const x = a.x + pt.x;
177:           const y = a.y + pt.y;
178:           if (i === 0) ctx.moveTo(x, y);
179:           else ctx.lineTo(x, y);
180:         });
181:         ctx.closePath();
182:         ctx.fill();
183:         ctx.stroke();
184:       } else {
185:         // fallback circle
186:         ctx.arc(a.x, a.y, a.radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
187:         ctx.fill();
188:         ctx.stroke();
189:       }
190:     });
191:     // HUD
192:     ctx.fillStyle = 'white';
193:     ctx.font = '16px sans-serif';
194:     ctx.fillText(`Fuel: ${ship.fuel.toFixed(0)}`, 10, 20);
195:     ctx.fillText(`Score: ${Math.floor(ship.distance)}` , 10, 40);
196:     if (gameOver) {
197:       ctx.fillStyle = 'red';
198:       ctx.font = '48px sans-serif';
199:       ctx.fillText('Game Over', width / 2 - 120, height / 2);
200:     }
201:   };
202: 
203:   const loop = timestamp => {
204:     const dt = (timestamp - lastTime) / 1000; // seconds
205:     lastTime = timestamp;
206:     update(dt);
207:     draw();
208:     if (!gameOver) requestAnimationFrame(loop);
209:   };
210: 
211:   // Start
212:   requestAnimationFrame(loop);
213: })();

(End of file - total 213 lines)
</content>
